将二重积分按 \(x\) 积分：

\[
\iint_D f(x)f(x^2-y)\,d\sigma
=\int_{-1}^{2} x\left(\int_{x^2-2}^{x^2+1} (x^2-y)\,dy\right)dx
\]

对内层积分令 \(u=x^2-y\)，则

\[
\int_{x^2-2}^{x^2+1}(x^2-y)\,dy=\int_{-1}^{2}u\,du=\frac{3}{2}
\]

所以

\[
\iint_D f(x)f(x^2-y)\,d\sigma
=\int_{-1}^{2}\frac{3}{2}x\,dx
=\frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{3}{2}
=\frac{9}{4}
\]
